positions.commentary: Cost Plus Drugs is the only pharmacy company that publishes an entire price list.

thesis: This episode argues that Cost Plus Drugs (COST) is unique among pharmacy companies for publishing its entire price list, a transparency feature that distinguishes it from competitors.
